description: Deterministic supplementary numerical and exact finite-state checks. The proofs establish the theorems; these checks are not formal or interval-certified verification.

metadata.model_selection: Explicit rational parameters; no random generator.
metadata.fixed_sample_arithmetic: Exact fractions for the union-state probabilities, weights, mean, and variance.
metadata.poisson_arithmetic: Exhaustive independent batch-presence states at 80 decimal digits.
metadata.large_binomial_method: Endpoint-scaled incomplete-beta integral, truncated at y=256 when necessary.
metadata.large_binomial_error_scope: The omitted-integral bound is analytic; mpmath quadrature and arithmetic are not certified.
